scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:admin
scripts.db:migrate: docker compose exec api npx prisma migrate dev --schema packages/api/prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.db:push: docker compose exec api npx prisma db push --schema packages/api/prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.db:seed: docker compose exec api node packages/api/scripts/seed.js
scripts.db:create-admin: docker compose exec api node packages/api/scripts/createAdmin.js
